notes.title: Major Update (versión 1.011)
notes.content:
[h1]Project Legion – Major Update (Version 1.011)[/h1]

Hello, survivors!

Since we launched Project Legion, we’ve read every comment, review and post you left. Many criticisms were harsh but on point: there was a lot to polish. This Major Update is our direct response to your feedback — we rewrote entire systems, squashed bugs and added new content.

Everything you’ll see below — the «Anna» map, the flamethrower, the Souls system, reconnection… — was born from what you asked for or the issues you reported. We want you to feel that Early Access is worth it and that your voices matter.
If something’s still off, let us know!

[h2]Highlight Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New map [b]«Anna»[/b] : a completely new setting starring one of Project Nightmares’ main antagonists.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/dbf258ff327da7de7e0904887fbf6d73c0b6b37a.gif[/img]
[*] New weapon: Flamethrower — continuous fire damage at short range; ignites enemies and drains their health over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/7329e6febce01a711641a52d5faadce85df29101.jpg[/img]
[*] New distraction item: Music box — attracts enemies in a radius, giving you time to escape or set an ambush.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/6f7d55323c4fb58b3756659fad5e08bb6f561966.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Souls[/b] system: collecting souls (by killing enemies, completing missions or finding rare items) now lets you buy characters and gear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/c85760e3d7e65328ee2691ebba3ca546700c7b45.jpg[/img]
[*] Tiered levels & re-balanced XP — groundwork for future progression rewards.
[*] New character skins.
[*] New light-orb types so you no longer sacrifice your right hand just to see.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/862c4e41deb3a8592a3d2c87369d88009465fbc3.gif[/img]
[] Dual-handing: mission item in the right hand + weapon in the left to defend yourself.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stamina drains less while running and when using Sixth Sense (Q).
[*] Healing syringes spawn randomly and restore health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/028505f6e293cef73803240c66f20472478f8a35.jpg[/img]
[*] Adjustable microphone volume and device selection; see an aura around a teammate who’s speaking.
[/list]

[h2]AI & Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] New co-op behaviour: if three enemies are grouped and you shoot one, the others become more aggressive for a while. We call these [b]reactions[/b] and plan to expand them. In the video you can see how enemies notice their teammate fall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/23736bf494f5a9f16115d9e8a3af1c963729ccc9.gif[/img]
[*] Henrietta and other bosses now sync capture/health/position correctly between host and client.
[*] Fixed Jacob being nearly invulnerable when detecting attacks.
[*] General pass: Jacob-map puppets, Henrietta fighters and other NPCs no longer get stuck in doors or mis-collide.
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer & Network[/h2]
[list]
[*] Room lists and reconnection rewritten: phantom lobbies and re-join issues are gone.
[*] Photon regions: obsolete cache disabled; far regions filtered to avoid high ping.
[*] Fixed a case where the client stayed in “connecting” after canceling/creating rooms, locking the game.
[*] Cursor no longer disappears for the client after a win.
[*] HUD cleans up when the host changes.
[/list]

[h2]Audio & VFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Global cinematic volume scales with music volume.
[*] Fixed multiple sound issues.
[*] Reduced camera shake when taking damage.
[/list]

[h2]Controls & UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased mouse sensitivity.
[*] Console now opens with INS (no longer F1).
[*] Fixed “janky” diagonal movement: walking, running and crouching feel smooth.
[*] Improved mission messages — text always appears on completion.
[*] 2D voice chat in lobby so you hear yourself even if the host switches scenes.
[/list]

[h2]Critical Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rescue while the monster drags: AI no longer breaks.
[*] Multiplayer sessions start without “couldn’t start multiplayer”.
[*] Mission objects that vanished (urns, skull) restored and synced.
[*] Skull missions and others no longer duplicate or soft-lock.
[*] Removed unnecessary logs for better performance.
[/list]

[h2]Next Steps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full gamepad support in progress.
[*] More uses for the level & XP system in future updates.
[/list]

[h2]Join our Community[/h2]
Got suggestions, bug reports or need squadmates? Join our Discord and become part of the legion: [url=https://discord.gg/FB5J9qCgh4]https://discord.gg/FB5J9qCgh4[/url]

notes.title: Project Legion's Biggest Update + Lowest Price Ever at Summer Fest!

notes.title: Version 1.010 - New Skins and Artifacts!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.010 - New Skins, Models, and Unique Artifacts![/h1]

We’re excited to announce Update 1.010 for Project Legion. In this version, we’ve added exciting new content to enhance personalization and gameplay experience, along with new systems to immerse you even further into the nightmare world we’ve created.
After reviewing your feedback, we took some time to adjust the game’s direction. The idea behind Project Legion has always been to feature multiple maps, enemies, and characters. However, at this stage of development, we needed to test the game in its alpha/beta state. Many mechanics and modules, especially those related to netcode, require testing in environments with more players and higher data transfer volumes.
Many of the issues you’ve mentioned in your reviews have already been fixed, and others are on their way to being resolved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/5bbcb737bc46a33183121c77abc0d8c1c3d1af71.gif[/img]

[h1]New Features and Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*][h3]4 New Skins and 2 Exclusive Models:[/h3]
We’ve added 4 new skins to customize your favorite characters. Additionally, 2 models will be available for purchase. Now you can stand out even more among players with these unique customization options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/e643d2d2c7b83681a638c58eb54575da7ab124d5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/ec0bf732fdbd1c56f175ecdf376ff1be207a3cd4.jpg[/img]

[*][h3]Innovative Light Artifacts:[/h3]
We’re introducing two new artifacts that light your path while you explore nightmares—no need to hold them in your hands! These artifacts follow the player, offering a more immersive and functional experience to face the horrors that lurk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/862c4e41deb3a8592a3d2c87369d88009465fbc3.gif[/img]

[*][h3]Bug Fixes and General Improvements:[/h3]
As always, we keep working on the finer details to make the game smoother and more enjoyable. This version includes several optimizations that improve stability and performance.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/8c806aee41e2406bfa86630ac43a29d3c12e79b6.gif[/img]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[list]
[*] We’re working on a new map that will offer a completely fresh challenge, full of terrifying details and surprises.
[*] We’re adding more enemies to enrich the variety and combat strategy.
[*] We’ll continue developing improvements based on your feedback, so keep sharing your thoughts with us!
[/list]

[h1]Thank You for Your Support[/h1]

The enthusiasm and feedback from our community drive us to keep expanding and improving Project Legion. We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it!

See you in the nightmare,
The Project Legion Team

notes.title: New Update 1.009: Head Bobbing Options and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.009 - Update and Important Improvements[/h1]

We’re excited to present the latest update for Project Legion! In this version, we’ve introduced new options for players who experience motion sickness, added new items related to “souls,” and fixed some reference issues in character animations. As always, your feedback is essential to help us refine the game experience.

[h1]New Features and Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*][h3]Camera Stabilization Parameter:[/h3]
We’ve added a new setting in the menu for those who experience motion sickness. You can now choose a configuration that reduces or eliminates camera wobble during gameplay. Adjusting the camera in an environment with simulations and resimulations at the networking level is a challenge since we need to maintain perfect synchronization among all players and ongoing actions. With this parameter, we aim to offer a more comfortable experience without compromising gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/c5d23376c5b892997f89b80e0298ffb0d42f3d36.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/c69c4c9602598a22436384609881328c005c6f71.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/18ffdf5e6b8f983614a619c3c59c41b045948bf9.png[/img]
We will also showcase a GIF video comparing the game with and without camera movement so you can clearly see the difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/8b50eaed915c730a5f132ec66644a59cb6b97a31.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/0587d2cc6caf9bf60d753dc87f2b38804e1cc62c.gif[/img]

[*][h3]New Items That Grant “Souls”:[/h3]
We’ve introduced new items in the game that allow you to earn “souls,” the in-game currency that we plan to expand in the future. As we move forward, we’ll keep tweaking the system so you can use these souls to purchase artifacts, skins, and other aesthetic or even functional items. Over time, certain skins may offer unique gameplay features, adding new strategic layers to the experience.

[*][h3]Fixes for Hand References:[/h3]
We’ve resolved various issues related to character hand references. Animations and hand positions should now look more natural and consistent.
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[list]
[*] We’ll continue refining the in-game economy based on “souls,” adding more ways to earn and spend them.
[*] We’ll evaluate the introduction of skins with unique gameplay benefits, listening to your feedback to properly balance these advantages.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You for Your Support[/h1]

Your enthusiasm for Project Legion drives us to keep improving and innovating. We’re grateful for all the feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. With your help, we’ll continue polishing every aspect of the game!

See you in the nightmare,
The Project Legion Team

notes.title: Update 1.008: Tutorial, Experience, and More
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.008 - New Update and Important Changes[/h1]

We’re excited to present the latest update for Project Legion! In this version, we’ve introduced new mechanics, fixed bugs, and improved several aspects of the game to enhance the player experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your input is essential in helping us take the game to the next level. 😊

[h1]New Features and Changes[/h1]

[list] 
[*] Initial Tutorial:
We’ve added the first version of the tutorial to help new players get familiar with the game mechanics and controls. We look forward to your feedback to improve it in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/5e8bfc6926ab5f0228c275ffcb5f221f2ecbb576.jpg[/img]

[*] Experience and Souls System

[h3]Souls:[/h3]
Souls act as the in-game currency used to purchase skins. For now, players can earn them by defeating enemies, and in the future, they may also unlock useful artifacts or even discover hidden maps.

[h3]Experience:[/h3]
Completing missions grants significantly more experience.
Defeating enemies gives experience, and if you’re playing in a team, it will be shared among the players closest to the kills.
Defeating multiple enemies in quick succession provides an experience bonus. The more enemies you kill in a short time, the more experience you’ll gain.
[*] New Maps in Development:
We are working on dynamic maps designed for old-school action and survival. These maps will focus on evasion and are perfect for adrenaline lovers.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and Improvements[/h1]

[list] 
[*] Resolved various issues related to model fabrics.
[*] Removed the capsule that appeared during player entry.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Henrietta Kedward level: The mission object that disappeared under certain circumstances now works properly.
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[list] 
[*] We will continue to adjust the experience system to offer more incentives in multiplayer matches.
[*] We’ll improve the tutorial based on your suggestions.
[*] We’ll keep developing dynamic maps and adding new ways to customize the game experience.

[b]Multiplayer Rewards:[/b]

[*]Playing solo: You’ll earn base experience.
[*]Playing with 1 friend: You’ll receive a small additional bonus on top of the base experience.
[*]Playing with 2 friends: The bonus will be even greater.
[*]Playing with a full group of 3 friends (4 players): You’ll get the highest experience bonus possible.
This system is designed to encourage cooperative play, rewarding collaboration among players.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You for Your Support![/h1]

Your enthusiasm for Project Legion motivates us to keep working on delivering the best game possible. Remember, your feedback is always welcome, and we’ll be attentive to any reports or suggestions.

See you in the game! 🎮
The Project Legion Team

notes.title: Version 1.007 - Physics Overhaul and Critical Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.007 - Major Update and Fixes[/h1]

Your feedback continues to be invaluable,
and we're excited to share the latest improvements to Project Legion!
Version 1.007 addresses critical issues, introduces new enhancements,
and lays the groundwork for upcoming features.

Thank you for helping us create a better gaming experience!

If you encounter any remaining issues, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

[h1]Critical Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved desynchronization in the game physics that caused erratic behavior in various objects.
[*] Fixed an issue where the key pickup sound did not play for the client.
[*] Players captured by enemies no longer remain immobilized with their leg raised if their teammate completes a mission while being dragged.
[*] Corrected behavior where the Fighter remained stationary if its target left the game.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Fighter to sometimes get trapped in rooms.
[*] Addressed an issue where the Fighter would stop moving if Henrietta killed its target.
[*] Puppets now properly stop colliding with players after death.
[*] Disconnection popups have been restructured to display a clear message for a few seconds and automatically return to the correct screen.
[*] Corrected the camera position when players are captured for the first time by an enemy.
[*] Resolved instances where some players were shown an incorrect ending.
[*] Fixed a bug where Henrietta grabbed a client while still showing an item in their hand.
[*] Resolved a random issue where, after the host was killed, the enemy pursued another player regardless of distance.
[*] Fixed occasional missing fire effects for molotovs on the client.
[*] Addressed an issue where, during level loading, if the host left the game, the client would lose mouse functionality.
[*] Jump mechanics for both host and client have been improved.
[*] Corrected the high dispersion issue causing blunderbuss shots to miss even when aiming accurately.
[*] Fixed duplicated door sounds when blocked.
[*] Corrected the appearance of the sandbox screen in the lobby.
[*] Puzzle pieces in Jacob’s rotating puzzle now function smoothly for the client.
[*] Adjusted mouse sensitivity to provide a better user experience.
[*] Fixed audio issues occurring before level loading.
[*] Stopped puppet footstep sounds from continuing after their death.
[*] Corrected Jacob’s AI to prevent him from targeting other players after grabbing the host.
[*] Fixed disappearing footstep sounds on map2.
[*] Added mission deployment sounds to enhance the gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h1]Next Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Players can now ignite the molotov with a clear visual cue to indicate a charging effect.
[*] Structured gameplay now waits for all players to be ready before starting the match, creating a more coordinated experience.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements and Upcoming Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We are working on implementing a tutorial to guide players through the game mechanics.
[*] Fixes to character models are in progress.
[*] Ongoing improvements to audio synchronization when the host disconnects and the client returns to the lobby.
[*] Adjustments to enemy behavior to prevent them from queuing up to attack players.
[*] Rebalancing and expansion of the experience system are in development.
[*] Plans to scale the game with additional features like an XP-based skin shop and enhanced weapon behaviors are underway.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You for Playing![/h1]
Your continued support inspires us to keep improving Project Legion.
This update addresses many of the issues you’ve reported and brings us closer to our vision for the game.

As always, your feedback helps shape our next steps.
Let us know what you think, and see you in the game! 😊

Team Project Legion

notes.title: Version 1.006 - New Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.006 - Important Update[/h1]

After listening to your feedback on Discord, social media, and Steam reviews, we have worked hard to improve your experience in Project Legion. This update includes critical fixes, new features, and significant gameplay improvements.

If you encounter any issues that persist, please let us know.

[h1]Critical Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the client could not hear ambient sounds on the Jacob map.
[*] Resolved a bug in the furnace mission where a torch was placed inside the geometry of another object.
[*] Furnace ignition sounds are now audible for clients.
[*] Fixed an issue where carrying a skull in hand prevented jumping and crouching.
[*] Fixed the issue where skulls disappeared when digging a grave.
[*] Added an animation to the furnace for burning remains.
[*] Clients can now hear the gate sound in map1 when it opens and displays the remains.
[*] The gate sound now matches its movement.
[*] Ambient lights have been reviewed; some previously inaudible are now working correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where remains placed by the client could be moved with the mouse.
[*] Added more time before the final furnace cutscene to enhance the narrative.
[*] Corrected the message that incorrectly displayed “placing coal” to the client when interacting with coal on the host.
[*] Fixed the issue where completing the final skull caused the progress marker to display an incorrect number.
[*] Increased sound playback capacity to prevent cuts or errors.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now carry a mission object in one hand while holding a weapon in the other for defense, adding more dynamism to gameplay.
[*] Next Friday: We’ll release a tutorial to help you better understand the game mechanics.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements and Upcoming Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We are working on Henrietta’s AI and other main enemies to offer more varied and balanced challenges.
[*] We are stabilizing the game’s physics, which are currently affected by object synchronization in the network.
[*] Identified some bugs that prevent returning to the lobby during specific gameplay sequences; we are replicating these issues to resolve them.
[*] With the update to a newer version of the networking system, some errors were introduced, which we are fixing. Our goal is to continuously update both the game and its underlying technologies, including the engine and networking system.
[*] We plan to scale the game with new levels, enemies with unique behaviors, and improvements to the weapons system.
[*] We still need to fix the XP and points system. Once fixed, we will implement a module to purchase skins.
[*] A setting will be added for those who suffer from motion sickness.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You for Your Continuous Support[/h1]
We know these changes are just the beginning, and we deeply appreciate your patience as we work to make Project Legion an unforgettable experience. As always, your feedback is crucial to further improvements. See you in the game! 😊

Team Project Legion

notes.title: Project Legion - Patch 1.005 Update
notes.content:
After talking with you on Discord, and reading reviews, emails, and messages on our social media, we have decided to start shifting the direction of the game, just as we did previously with Project Nightmares.
As far as we know, we have completely solved the issues mentioned below, but if some of them persist, please let us know.

[h1]Version 1.005 - Critical Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The entire networking layer has been updated to a new version to reduce data transmission and bandwidth usage.
[*] Fixed a bug where items dropped to the ground sometimes disappeared.
[*] Fixed a bug where items on the floor could clip into the ground.
[*] Fixed the blur effect when looking at the ground.
[*] Fixed a bug where mission objects would sometimes disappear when dropped.
[*] Changed the console key from F1 to Insert.
[*] Corrected the Simplified Chinese translation.
[*] Adjusted the sonar mechanic to prevent confusion. Since there is no inventory system, the sonar will no longer highlight items already held in hand.
[*] Fixed the issue where items not ready for interaction would still light up.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started work on a tutorial to make the gameplay easier to understand. This should be ready by next Friday.
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We will be making adjustments to some gameplay elements to prevent instant kills and make it more accessible.
[*] Introducing difficulty modes to cater to different play styles.
[*] We are changing Henrietta's AI. Currently, Henrietta is blind but can hear across the entire map, which makes it too challenging. We will be modifying this to make the gameplay less punishing.
[/list]

[h1]Planned Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The points and experience system is currently not working correctly, and this is something we plan to fix. Our goal is to ensure that points and experience are accurately tracked during Early Access, so achievements are not lost upon the full release.
[*] Players will be able to use points to purchase skins, and experience will unlock new abilities in the future.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing support! 😄

Project Legion Team

notes.title: Project Legion IS OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Project Legion[/b] is now available in [b]Early Access[/b]. Rally your team and brace yourselves for the horror that awaits!

[previewyoutube=Wyrt_qa34xk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is Project Legion?[/h2]

Project Legion is a co-op horror game for up to 4 players. You and your team are tasked with solving mysterious cases and completing dangerous missions, all while exploring eerie locations and facing unspeakable horrors. Cooperate to uncover secrets and find a way to survive the lurking evil... or fall one by one. The ultimate question remains: who will be the last one standing?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800850/Project_Legion/

[h3]Some features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Up to four-player co-op gameplay
[*] Defend yourself with melee weapons
[*] Use firearms for ranged attacks
[*] Illuminate your surroundings with various light sources
[*] Dual-wield items, combining a light source with a weapon
[*] Uncover hidden areas
[*] Rescue your teammates
[*] Kill enemies to progress
[*] Earn experience points
[*] Collect points to level up
[*] Gather souls, a currency to spend
[*] Use the in-game chat for team coordination
[*] Play across two distinct scenarios
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/b2556a5601d37e01362441fd007035ed12964a73.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features planned for the coming months:
[/h3]
[b]Voice Chat[/b]: Soon, you’ll be able to communicate with your friends in-game using your microphone, opening the door to new strategies and experiences.

[b]AI Improvements[/b]: We're working on smarter characters that react to sounds, voice chat, and adapt their behavior based on how you play. If you decide to face enemies with aggression, be ready for an equally intense response.

[b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b]: We’ll be analyzing every detail and balancing the difficulty based on community feedback, ensuring an exciting but fair experience.

[b]Skin System[/b]: In the near future, we’ll introduce a skin purchasing system so you can customize your characters and stand out on the battlefield.

[b]Loot System[/b]: We're considering implementing a loot system so you can obtain items and rewards while playing, adding an extra layer of excitement and progression.

[b]Animation Improvements[/b]: We’ll be enhancing animations to make character movements feel smoother and more natural, increasing immersion and the visual quality of the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/54f0c62745f3e7079b48c51552abd7c4417d785d.jpg[/img]

For those who know us from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/812070/Project_Nightmares_Case_36_Henrietta_Kedward/]Project Nightmares Case 36[/url], you already know we’re all about solid performance. [b]Project Legion[/b] is optimized to deliver a smooth experience: even on an older rig with an i7 3770 and a GTX 1060, [b]Project Legion[/b] runs at over 60 FPS, depending on the area and the number of client resimulations in the game. Our goal is to ensure you can enjoy a high-quality experience, even on more modest setups. For this release, the player who starts the match will be the host, and other players will connect to their server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/4f0abd7f0b361b606f8ca57ab219db89ee709e15.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]

Don't hesitate to join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/petRMS3kqw]Discord[/url] to chat about Project Legion or to find other players ready to play with you!

notes.title: New Update: Choose Your Servers!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi guys![/h2]

We are excited to announce a new update that will greatly enhance your gaming experience. You can now choose the servers you want to play on. This update allows you to select your preferred region, whether it's the USA, Europe, South America, Australia, Asia, and more.

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Region Selection: Choose the region of the servers you prefer to play on. This will provide you with a better connection and a smoother gaming experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/7ed4c54ef4ca3f8bc6bb514f40e3606d295530f4.jpg[/img]


[h3]Automatic Selection Option:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you prefer, you can let the game automatically find rooms with the lowest ping or those closest to you. If nearby rooms are not available, you will have the option to select rooms that are farther away, depending on the number of players currently online.
[/list]

[h3]Room Filters:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Room Visualization: Now you can view all available rooms and their players.
[*] Region-Based Room Search: Easily find rooms in your selected region.
[*] Password Room Filter: Activate this filter to avoid viewing rooms protected by a password.
[*] Alphabetical Sorting: Room names are now sorted alphabetically.
[*] Priority to Empty Rooms: Empty rooms will be shown first, while rooms that are already in play will be listed at the end.
[/list]

We are confident that these improvements will make your gaming experience more enjoyable and efficient. We look forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy this new update!

See you in the nightmares! 🕯️

Follow Us:
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/petRMS3kqw
- Twitter: https://x.com/ncdevelopers

Thank you for your support and courage,
NCStudio.

notes.title: Important Update: Name Change and Release Date
notes.content:
[h2]Hi guys![/h2]

We want to share an important update about our game. Due to some confusion with our previous title, some of you thought our game was "Project Nightmares Case 36: Henrietta Kedward" with a multiplayer mode. We want to clarify that, although our game exists in the [i]Project Nightmares[/i] universe, it has entirely different mechanics and offers a unique experience.

For this reason, we have decided to change the name of our game to avoid misunderstandings and better reflect its essence and gameplay. We are pleased to announce that the new title of the game is [h3][b]Project Legion[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/c80b87c88f2d48209d1407ebf05a719e1ff528ba.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to confirm that [b]Project Legion[/b] will be launching in mid-October. This gives us enough time to polish the game further and ensure you have the best experience possible from day one. Mark your calendars and get ready for an exciting journey!

Additionally, we are excited to announce that our playtest has been going very well and will continue throughout July. We have received valuable feedback and are fixing and improving many aspects of the game thanks to your support. We also have a [u][b]new map[/b][/u] that we are sure you will enjoy!

Plus, stay tuned for [u][b]new characters[/b][/u] coming this Halloween!

Thank you for your understanding and continuous support. See you in the [i]Project Nightmares[/i] universe!

notes.title: Join the First Playtest of Project Nightmares Multiplayer!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, brave patients![/h2]

We are thrilled to announce the first playtest for [b]Project Nightmares Multiplayer[/b]! This is your exclusive opportunity to dive into the cooperative horror game we've been crafting. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we can't wait to hear what you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/1b05428629b63890d7756dbce643716cf0f7b498.png[/img]

[h3]What to Expect:[/h3]
- [b]Terrifying Co-Op Gameplay[/b]: Team up with friends or other players to face challenges together.
- [b]Atmospheric Horror[/b]: Immerse yourself in an environment designed to keep you on the edge.
- [b]Influence the Game[/b]: Your feedback during this playtest will directly impact the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/c0b639c9c2dc262b8b9571e86c0c954e04396900.gif[/img]

[h3]How to Join[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910730/f718ee710139d6265cc3a910a1c249067becb05a.png[/img]

2. [b]Check Your Email:[/b] Keep an eye on your inbox for the invitation and further instructions.

Don’t miss this chance to be a part of the early stages of Project Nightmares Multiplayer. Spaces are limited, so sign up now and prepare to face the darkness!

Sign up here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800850/Project_Nightmares_Multiplayer/

See you in the nightmares! 🕯️

NCStudio.
